subject: Money
title: Crypto Exchanges
description: A short lesson to help you apply Crypto Exchanges.

hook.text: FTX was the world's third-largest crypto exchange. In November 2022, it collapsed in 10 days. $8 billion vanished.

buildup.text: Exchanges let you buy and sell crypto with regular money. Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken handle billions in daily trades.

discovery.text: They work like stock brokerages: you deposit money, place orders, and pay fees. The exchange matches buyers and sellers.

twist.text: Unlike stock brokerages, many crypto exchanges are poorly regulated. Funds have been stolen, frozen, or misused.

climax.text: Use regulated exchanges. Withdraw large amounts to your own wallet. Don't leave life savings on any exchange.

punchline.text: Exchanges are doors. Don't live in the doorway.

quiz.question: Why should you avoid leaving large amounts on crypto exchanges?
options: Exchanges can collapse or be poorly regulated
